data.content_ref: inline:The problem explicitly asks 'which of the two properties' (idempotency or safety) an append-only log requires of its writers, and instructs drawing on 'published definitions.' SRC_001 refuses to pick either, instead coining 'monotonic-append-safety' with no published basis. More damningly, its own first countercondition concedes the entire claim collapses if this third property is a special case of generic safety — and it is: preserving 'immutability, monotonic growth, tail-ordering' is exactly safety (preserving specific structural invariants of the system). SRC_002's own definition of safety as 'preserving the invariants of a specific system' subsumes this. The target thus fails to answer the asked question and its novel distinction is self-undermining.
